process.title: Implement base62.py (Base62 encode/decode) with tests
process.scope: Owns exactly base62.py and tests/test_base62.py. Does not touch chaocipher.py, centroid.py, any other test file, or any existing file. Standard library only; no imports from other deliverable modules.
process.task:
Implement the Base62 codec exactly to the acceptance section below, then write its test file. Only create these two new files; do not modify any existing file. Use only the standard library and do not import the other deliverable modules.

SPEC:
- Alphabet pinned as `0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz` (indices 0-61 map to those characters in order).
- `base62_encode(n: int) -> str`: n must be int (bool rejected); non-int raises TypeError; n < 0 raises ValueError; `base62_encode(0) == "0"`.
- `base62_decode(s: str) -> int`: non-str raises TypeError; empty string raises ValueError; characters outside the alphabet raise ValueError.

ACCEPTANCE (transcribed item by item; every item needs a test case):
- `base62_encode(0) == "0"`
- `base62_encode(1) == "1"`
- `base62_encode(9) == "9"`
- `base62_encode(10) == "A"`
- `base62_encode(35) == "Z"`
- `base62_encode(36) == "a"`
- `base62_encode(61) == "z"`
- `base62_encode(62) == "10"`
- `base62_encode(63) == "11"`
- `base62_encode(12345) == "3D7"`
- `base62_encode(3843) == "zz"`
- `base62_encode(238327) == "zzz"`
- `base62_encode(987654321) == "14q60P"`
- `base62_decode("0") == 0`
- `base62_decode("3D7") == 12345`
- `base62_decode("zzz") == 238327`
- `base62_decode("14q60P") == 987654321`
- Round-trip: `base62_decode(base62_encode(n)) == n` for n in 0, 1, 61, 62, 3844, 10**12, 2**63 - 1
- `base62_encode(-1)` raises ValueError
- `base62_encode(1.5)`, `base62_encode(True)`, `base62_encode("12")` raise TypeError
- `base62_decode("")`, `base62_decode("!")`, `base62_decode("a b")` raise ValueError
- `base62_decode(123)`, `base62_decode(None)` raise TypeError

There are no body-vs-acceptance contradictions for this module; no conflict note applies.

After implementing, run the checks from the repository root and fix any failure before finishing.
